name: USLE Soil Loss Rate (t/ha)
definition: Potential annual sheet and rill soil loss; baseline erosion pressure.

name: USLE Soil Loss Total (t/yr)
definition: Total modeled annual sheet and rill soil loss.

name: Sediment Export Rate (t/ha)
definition: Modeled sediment reaching streams per unit area; baseline pressure.

name: Sediment Export Total (t/yr)
definition: Total modeled annual sediment delivered to streams.

name: Sediment Deposition Rate (t/ha)
definition: Modeled sediment deposition per unit area.

name: Sediment Deposition Total (t/yr)
definition: Total modeled annual sediment deposition.

name: Avoided Export Rate (t/ha)
definition: Modeled sediment export avoided by current land cover; retention benefit, not a forecast of restoration gains.

name: Avoided Export Total (t/yr)
definition: Total modeled avoided sediment export.

name: Avoided Soil Erosion Rate (t/ha)
definition: Modeled soil erosion avoided by current land cover.

name: Avoided Soil Erosion Total (t/yr)
definition: Total modeled avoided soil erosion.

name: Nitrogen Total Export Rate (kg/ha)
definition: Total nitrogen export per unit area.

name: Nitrogen Total Export Load (kg/yr)
definition: Total nitrogen export load.

name: Nitrogen Surface Export Rate (kg/ha)
definition: Surface nitrogen export per unit area.

name: Nitrogen Subsurface Export Rate (kg/ha)
definition: Subsurface nitrogen export per unit area.

name: Phosphorus Surface Export Rate (kg/ha)
definition: Surface phosphorus export per unit area.

name: Phosphorus Surface Export Load (kg/yr)
definition: Total surface phosphorus export load.

name: Degraded Land Share (% area)
definition: Fraction of mapped land classified as degraded.

name: Stable Land Share (% area)
definition: Fraction of mapped land classified as stable.

name: Improving Land Share (% area)
definition: Fraction of mapped land classified as improving.

name: Water Yield Depth (mm/yr)
definition: Modeled annual water yield depth; not seasonal baseflow.

name: Water Yield Total Volume (m³/yr)
definition: Modeled total annual water yield volume.
